description: Scale a 10-bit value (clamped to 1023) to 8 bits with rounding: (v * 255 + 511) / 1023
notes: Real-world image and ADC idiom written by us. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake keeps a umin, a multiplication and a udiv by 1023: 7 IR instructions (the backend expands the udiv into a multiply-high sequence). Whether a cheaper exact form exists is unknown.
